name: page-preview-state
goal: Each declared page preview selects its own recorded state in both renderers

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Agent settings has an explicit preview state but its scenario names no units per state. Reports would select the first compact-controls screenshot instead of the Settings page.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: test/utils/preview-binding.test.ts used only ideal synthetic states. Extend it across every committed active page preview to require its own state membership, so both catalog renderers agree.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 360ca8c2; red c76e6376f785a5f7db57efceec0fc82148de8109a9fff99de553187fc5cd6c5f. The registry drops real page preview bindings and catalogShot ignores the exact requested state/viewport. Both standardized utility assertions fail on unchanged product.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
